`abstract class NodeFieldChangeEvent<N extends Node, V>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`NodeEvent<N>`](/reference/events/nodeevent/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`NodeFieldChangeEvent.Pre`](/reference/events/nodefieldchangeevent-pre/), [`NodeFieldChangeEvent.Post`](/reference/events/nodefieldchangeevent-post/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeFieldChangeEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/node/NodeFieldChangeEvent.java)

The change of the text of a field, with the text before and after and the value read from it, in a cancellable `Pre` and a `Post`.

## Description

[`FieldNode.beforeChange`](/reference/controls/fieldnode/#FieldNode-method-beforeChange) receives a [`NodeFieldChangeEvent.Pre`](/reference/events/nodefieldchangeevent-pre/) and can refuse the edit; [`FieldNode.onChange`](/reference/controls/fieldnode/#FieldNode-event-onChange) receives a [`NodeFieldChangeEvent.Post`](/reference/events/nodefieldchangeevent-post/) once the text changed.
